title: Slay the Streamer 2
description:
Twitch and YouTube chat votes on the streamer's choices: run start (act variant), Neow and mid-run Ancient blessings, card rewards, and act bosses. Inspired by Tempus's Slay the Streamer for StS1.

Configuration lives in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\slay_the_streamer_2.json and in the in-game Mods screen once connected.

Setup guide and README: https://github.com/Surfinite/slay-the-streamer-2

Demo: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2782280062
changeNote: v0.3.1: enemy naming is now a raffle weighted by participation - every vote a chatter takes part in earns one ticket (one per vote, number-spam doesn't help), each enemy draws a name by ticket, and being drawn spends that chatter's tickets until they vote again. Frequent voters get named more often; repeat draws still become 'Jr.', then 'III'. If the raffle ever runs dry (quiet chat), it falls back to the previous fair rotation so enemies always get names. Tested against game Beta v0.111.0.
